methodologyNotes: Covers cordless (battery-powered) nail guns / nailers sold at a published US price, spanning brad, finish, and framing tools. Excludes pneumatic nailers that require an external air compressor, corded electric staplers, and manual hammer tackers. Price is typical US MSRP/street (bare tool unless the model is kit-only), USD. nailerType is the fastener class: brad, finish, framing, pin, roofing, or flooring. fastenerGauge is the nail gauge as published (e.g. "18 ga", "16 ga", "15 ga"), or "round head" for full-head framing nails. nailLengthRangeIn is the min-to-max accepted fastener length in inches. collationAngleDeg is the magazine collation angle in degrees (0 for straight magazines). magazineCapacityNails is the maximum number of nails held in the magazine. driveMechanism is the drive type: flywheel, air-spring, nitrogen-spring, or gas-combustion. batteryVoltageV is the nominal battery-platform voltage in volts. shotsPerChargeNails is the manufacturer-stated nails driven per full charge on the referenced battery; null if not disclosed. weightLbs is bare-tool weight in pounds. firingModes is the actuation option(s): sequential, contact, or dual (sequential + contact/bump). brushlessMotor is true if the tool uses a brushless motor; null for gas-combustion tools. depthAdjustmentToolFree is true if drive depth adjusts without tools.
